svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print on its side (an 11 mm face on the bed), 100 % infill.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A bridge 11 mm wide: top bar 36 x 10 mm, two legs 4 mm thick and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 15.25 mm tall, 29 mm apart between centres (fix F3).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3.4 mm hole down through each leg and the bar, with a 6.2 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: counterbore 2 mm deep in the top for each screw head.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the bar lies on top of the cell, 46 mm from the cell's spring end;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the legs stand on the two strap bosses beside the cradle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two M3 x 25 low-head screws down through the strap into the inserts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It holds the cell down in a drop: 870 N peak at 1.45 times margin.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the cell cannot lift and the screw heads are below 31 mm.
